name: ConQuesT
organizer: Kansas City Science Fiction and Fantasy Society
blurb: Kansas City's longest-running fan-run science fiction and fantasy convention, on hiatus since 2023 while seeking a new venue.
notes: On hiatus: the last edition was ConQuesT 54, June 2-4, 2023 at the Hilton Kansas City Airport. The official site still shows that 2023 event with no newer announcement, and Wikipedia states ConQuesT has been on hiatus pending a suitable venue. No new dates found via web search as of 2026-10-05.
